headline: Low clouds are holding flights into San Francisco.

items.text: A ground delay program is holding flights into San Francisco until 8:59 PM PT because of low clouds. Delays average 45 minutes, up to 110 minutes.
The other hubs are running normally; all seven reporting so far today are at 84% on time or better.
A separate ground delay program is holding flights into Seattle until 9:59 PM PT. Delays average 32 minutes, up to 82 minutes.

Possible actions for tomorrow, none in effect now: ground stops or ground delay programs for flights into Boston after tomorrow 1:00 PM ET, New York LaGuardia (also JFK) after tomorrow 10:00 AM ET, and San Diego after tomorrow 9:00 AM PT, and a ground stop for Miami (also Fort Lauderdale) after tomorrow 1:00 PM ET.

traveler_note.text: If you are flying to San Francisco or Seattle, check your flight status before leaving for the airport.
